minutes.headline: Planning Board voted on the warrant article rezoning two Mass Ave lots from commercial to limited business/residential.
minutes.summary: The board held a continued public hearing on the rezoning of parts of two lots on Mass Ave, closed it, and voted on the article; the captions give no count. It also heard liaison reports, a stormwater (MS4) permit briefing, a Scenic Road bylaw update, and Town Meeting preparation. The board agreed no extra Saturday meeting was needed.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board closed a continued public hearing on rezoning parts of two Mass Ave lots from commercial to limited business/residential.
The board then voted to support the rezoning article as submitted; it passed with at least one abstention, and the count was not audible.
The board decided against a separate Saturday meeting before Town Meeting; members will arrive early informally.
The board heard a stormwater (MS4) permit briefing, and the town does not own the specialized vacuum truck that separator maintenance needs.
The board will revise its rules and regulations first, targeting fall or early winter, and then the bylaws.

why_it_matters: The rezoning changes what can be built on two Mass Ave parcels, and residents will be asked to vote on the article at Town Meeting.
Stormwater permit duties and road underfunding can become future costs for the town budget, which is mostly taxes, though no amount was discussed with the town.
watch_next: Town Meeting vote on the Mass Ave rezoning article.
Recent traffic count data the planner is to bring before the next meeting, for comparison with the 2007 Highfield Village study.
